newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Overseas loan raised to $100 mln.
newsitem.headline: China Overseas loan raised to $100 mln.

text.p: China Overseas Land and Investment's loan facility has been increased to $100 million from $60 million, arranger Sanwa Bank said Monday.
The facility has a final maturity of three years. It pays an interest margin of 130 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Management fees are 90 basis points for the co-arrangers, 75 basis points for lead managers and 60 basis points for managers.
Sanwa Bank is the sole arranger.
Co-arrangers are Australia and New Zealand Banking Corp, BNP Hong Kong, HypoBank Hong Kong, Peregrine Fixed Income, Wing Lung Bank, and Yien Yieh Commercial Bank, Hong Kong.
Lead managers are Arab Banking Corp Singapore, Bank of Communications Hong Kong, CARIPLO S.p.A Hong Kong, Credit Lyonnais Hong Kong, Development Bank of Singapore and KorAm Bank Hong Kong.
Managers are Banca Commerciale Italiana Hong Kong, Hana Finance Asia, Mitsui Leasing and Development Hong Kong, Bank of East Asia, Kredietbank Singapre, and Shanghai International Finance Co.

As of 10th March, 1997, the company has a market capitalisation of approximately HK$24 billion, ranked thirty-first out of some 600 listed companies in Hong Kong, Sun Wen Jie, chairman of the company said.
The company is "actively engaged" in China infrastructural development and low-cost housing projects in Shenzhen and Beijing, he said.
The red chip company will also be taking part in future land acqusition in Hong Kong, but Sun declined to comment on how much the company will spend on land bank expansion this year.
